ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based playground for breaking down complex Data Structures and Algorithms with step-by-step memory tracking and execution flow animations, tailored specifically for the DSAverse rounds.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of the DSAverse challenge by providing a tool that helps participants master the exact problem-solving and algorithmic concepts being tested.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered adaptive practice engine that generates custom multiple-choice quizzes on computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms to help contestants ace Round 1.
ideas.title: QuizPrep AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and participants feel directly by offering targeted preparation for the quiz round of the event.

ideas.pitch: A performance and time-complexity analysis tool that evaluates user-submitted beginner solutions and suggests optimal algorithmic improvements with Big-O breakdown.
ideas.title: CodeHeuristics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuine technical utility by helping beginner programmers bridge the gap between working code and optimal code for the DSA Challenge tracks.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative, real-time code-review workspace designed for women developers to solve and discuss complex coding problems together during intense 48-hour sprints.
ideas.title: PeerCode Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the community-driven, empowering ethos of Elite Her by fostering collaborative problem-solving among women in tech.

ideas.pitch: A flashcard and pattern-recognition trainer built specifically for mastering common algorithmic paradigms like sliding window, two pointers, and dynamic programming.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Pattern Deck
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the pedagogical goals of DSAverse, helping participants internalize patterns needed for both medium and hard coding rounds.
